notes.title: Another patch! - June 8, 2025 - v9.4.6
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who provided feedback on the early builds of the game!



Changes in this update: 

 Fix various broken logic and missing message while sitting

 Fix missing music after choosing "undo" after an ending

 Add smoother hinting around the checklist



Thanks for sticking with us!

notes.title: Oops! Time for a patch.
notes.notes:
Just like the ISS, MoonShot needed a patch!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616674/675cef32877b15d33419ec8ba605dbf8787fecd5.png

Thanks for your patience with launch-day issues.  Here are the things we fixed in the this latest build (v9.4.3):


  Fix achievement popups for repeated achievements
  Fix several issues with autosave/autorestore
  Fix bad state after autorestore, which triggered the game to reboot
  Fix cloud sync backups getting out of sync
  Fix saved game being inappropriately loaded in some cases (e.g. after game over)
  Fix saved game being inappropriately deleted in some cases


The fixes for the autosave/autorestore system necessitated a breaking change, so your game will start over when you load it again.  Apologies for that, and hopefully you didn't lose too much in just one day.
